text:
ana: Heads-up: reproducible duplicate-processing in the onboarding sample when a 429 hits exactly during token rotation + immediate resume. Repro below.

ana: Repro steps:
1) start long-running streaming request to /v1/chat
2) token TTL expires mid-stream; next chunk gets 429
3) SDK refreshes token and resends the same chunk envelope immediately
4) Server processed both envelopes -> duplicate side-effects

mike: do we attach any idempotency key on stream-level ops? I think sampleapp uses per-frame uuids which change on retry.

ana: correct. sample currently sets frame-id each send.

priya: quick fixes: (A) attach a stable operation id on the initial request (header X-RW-Op-Id) and include it in retried envelopes, (B) add full jitter to refresh retry instead of immediate retry.

priya: suggested jitter: sleep = random(0, base * 2**attempt), base=200ms, cap 10s. avoids synchronized immediate retries after refresh.

mike: server-side also cheap to dedupe: keep seen op ids for 60s in a bounded cache and return 409 for duplicates. docs should state TTL and max clamp.

ana: sampleapp patch idea (node):
```
const opId = uuidv4();
fetch('/v1/streams/chat', { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${tkn}`, 'X-RW-Op-Id': opId } });
// include opId in chunk envelopes on retry
```

priya: parity note: Java SDK currently exposes no hook to set operation id for streams; Python exposes an opaque resume token. we need consistent SDK API: setOperationId(opId) on all languages.

ci-bot: opened ticket RW-5012: "devex: op-id + refresh-jitter parity + sampleapp test" assigned to @priya.

ops-bot: FYI incident 2026-03-20-22 auto-resolved; follow-up RW-5012.

mike: test plan: add deterministic harness that forces TTL to -1 for token mid-stream and asserts exactly one server-side action recorded. Also assert response header `X-RW-Dedupe: accepted|duplicate` when feature flag on.

ana: agreed. I'll add onboarding docs note explaining X-RW-Op-Id and Idempotency-Expiry header for edge cases.

priya: I'll prototype the jitter change in SDK and add interop tests across node/python/java. Will share PR link.

mike: thanks. small follow-up: consider defaulting mutating non-idempotent calls to include an `Idempotency-Key` header in all SDKs so sampleapp doesn't need to learn it immediately.

priya: +1 but make opt-out. we'll include in the parity checklist. :white_check_mark:
